headline: Approved a collective bargaining agreement with the Pawtucket Teachers Association and a contract with Amerigis Educational Staffing for special education nursing care.
summary: Members approved a new contract with the Pawtucket Teachers Association. They also approved a contract with Amerigis Educational Staffing for one-to-one nursing care for special education students. The meeting also included a state presentation on school housing aid and a capital reserve update.
decisions: Approved the August 12, 2026 meeting minutes, with six yea votes and one abstention.
Approved sealing the executive session minutes, unanimously.
Approved the collective bargaining agreement with the Pawtucket Teachers Association, with all members voting yea.
Approved the 2027 meeting schedule as amended, unanimously.
Approved the contract with Amerigis Educational Staffing for 1:1 nursing care for special education students, unanimously.
